description: Boundary coverage for HTTP middleware: thrown routes with custom messages, thrown routes without state middleware (no clear), and successful routes without an error reporter.

cases.expected_output:
route=/boom
status=500
body=internal_error_response
notify_count=1
notified_message=Kaboom!
next_error_handler_count=1
clear_count=1

route=/noclear
status=500
body=internal_error_response
notify_count=1
notified_message=NoState
next_error_handler_count=1
clear_count=0

route=/health
status=200
body=OK
notify_count=0
notified_message=none
next_error_handler_count=0
clear_count=1
